evidence.quote: ranging from 10$^{14}$ to 10$^{18}$ cm$^{-2}$ in logarithmic scale and from 75 to 300 K by increments of 5 K, respectively.

findings_qualitative.value: 15 species and 16 isotopologues securely detected towards A, 11 tentative

evidence.quote: In total, 15 different species as well as 16 isotopologues, have been securely detected, while 11 additional species and isotopologues are tentatively identified towards IRAS 16293A.

claims.hypothesis: Do COM abundances relative to CH3OH differ between the two binary components?
claims.experiment: LTE fits at offset positions and pairwise statistical distance
claims.result: Half of the species are significantly lower towards A, at ~2 sigma (factor of two)
claims.finding: Selective differentiation with three categories of species

evidence.quote: These separations represent a factor of two difference in the relative abundance ratio between IRAS16293A and B. This corresponds to a significance of 2$\sigma$

claims.hypothesis: Is the abundance difference linked to spatial distribution and sublimation temperature?
claims.result: Depleted species are more compact around the continuum peak
claims.finding: Stratification of COMs in the hot corino

evidence.quote: the emission distribution of the depleted species towards IRAS 16293A in comparison to IRAS 16293B is located around the continuum peak position

claims.result: CH3OCH2OH and t-C2H5OCH3 detected towards B; upper limits towards A
claims.finding: First detection in a low-mass star-forming region

evidence.quote: this is the first time they were detected in a low mass star-forming region

why_this_method.value: CH3OH used as reference since H2 column density has only lower limits from optically thick dust

evidence.quote: H$_2$ was not used as a reference for the estimation of the abundances because only the lower limit of H$_2$ column density can be determined from the optically thick dust emission.

limitations_admitted.value: Statistical errors not conservative given LTE assumptions; neglected effects such as beam dilution and self-absorption

evidence.quote: This suggests that the proper statistical estimate of the errors is not conservative considering the underlying hypotheses of the LTE model

referee_caveats_inferred: Single offset position per source, so abundance differences may reflect spatial extent rather than chemistry
Weight factor of three is arbitrary
Adopted uncertainties are ad hoc, so 2 sigma significance is weak
